# Sherpa-ONNX Vendor Files

These files are the official browser WebAssembly speaker-diarization build from `k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx`.

Source:

- Release: `https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/releases/tag/v1.13.3`
- Asset: `sherpa-onnx-wasm-simd-v1.13.3-speaker-diarization.tar.bz2`
- Download SHA256: `BD9645354E5EB7D261DC5B8227E46937615A53571250F3E7EA11D2AF4899E3AC`

Runtime files kept in this directory:

- `sherpa-onnx-speaker-diarization.js`
- `sherpa-onnx-wasm-main-speaker-diarization.js`
- `sherpa-onnx-wasm-main-speaker-diarization.wasm`
- `sherpa-onnx-wasm-main-speaker-diarization.data`

Do not replace these with `sherpa-onnx-wasm-nodejs.*`; the Node.js runtime is not the browser build.
